title: htc-heom-fast: Matrix-free scaled HEOM dynamics for symmetric HTC/Tavis-Cummings models
description: A small research-oriented Python/Numba package for matrix-free scaled hierarchical equations of motion simulations of symmetric Holstein-Tavis-Cummings and Tavis-Cummings models in the first-excitation manifold with site-local Drude-Lorentz baths.
